roadmap.title: Build the Conservatory and advance long counters
roadmap.description: Follow the opening tutorial, establish plort and food production, check both shops and the Comm Station each day, open every ranch expansion, and advance the income, Gordo, treasure, friendship, and crafting counters.

roadmap.title: Explore Rainbow Island and finish specialist challenges
roadmap.description: Open Ember Valley, Starlight Strand, and Powderfall Bluffs; exploit weather safely; deploy linked gadgets and portals; craft Quantum Drones; gather the four rare resources; and complete the 120-point Slimeball setup.

roadmap.title: Clear the Grey Labyrinth story
roadmap.description: Use Radiant Projectors to enter the Labyrinth, fill Shadow Collectors, open the three-plort route to the Prismacore, make three Night Market purchases, activate five Harmonizers, and stabilize the core.

roadmap.title: Complete the post-1.2 Slimepedia
roadmap.description: Use the category counts and undiscovered tiles to finish every required slime, resource, weather, toy, world, Ranch, and Science entry, including Sprinkles but excluding blueprints and Radiant variants.

achievements.description: Enter the Prismacore within the Grey Labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Load Shadow, Sloomber, and Twin Plorts into their statues, then enter the @loc{Prismacore} portal.

guide.context: The three linked statues guard the route to a Twin Gordo: the Twin statue is at a tower base, while the Shadow and Sloomber statues are on elevated structures reached with the Jetpack.

steps.text: Collect one @item{Shadow Plort}, one @item{Sloomber Plort}, and one @item{Twin Plort} in the Grey Labyrinth.
Find the three matching statues around the elevated bridge-and-tower complex and fire the correct plort into each statue to open their shared door.
Follow the opened route upstairs and ride the geyser into the Twin Gordo room; activate the stair mechanism, pass through the new door, and drop through the hole.
Activate the lower mechanism to clear the fog, follow the revealed path, and jump into the colorful portal at its end to enter the Prismacore.

achievements.description: Fly for 5 seconds using the jetpack.
achievements.summary: Use the Jetpack continuously for @mechanic{five seconds} without releasing the jump control.

guide.context: A 200-energy capacity gives enough uninterrupted flight time; releasing the control even briefly resets the five-second interval.

steps.text: Craft the Jetpack and enough Power Core upgrades to reach 200 maximum energy.
From safe open ground, hold the jump control to start the Jetpack and keep holding it for at least five seconds.

achievements.description: Craft 8 unique player upgrades.
achievements.summary: Craft @mechanic{eight different player upgrades} at the Conservatory Fabricator.

guide.context: Duplicate upgrade tiers do not replace the requirement for eight unique upgrade entries; later recipes need resources from several regions.

steps.text: Enter the basement behind the Ranch House and deposit required plorts and materials into the Refinery.
Use the Fabricator to craft eight differently named player upgrades, checking the achievement after the eighth unique recipe completes.

achievements.description: Purchase 5 Ranch Expansions.
achievements.summary: Purchase all @mechanic{five Conservatory ranch expansions}; use a fresh save only if the Complete Conservatory counter on a save begun before patch 1.2.1 remains stuck.

guide.context: Patch 1.2.1 fixed achievement progress sometimes failing to track. The five kiosks are arranged as one beyond the entrance and two on each side.

steps.text: Earn and retain enough newbucks to buy every Conservatory expansion, then visit all five expansion kiosks.
Purchase each expansion and confirm the achievement counter reaches five of five.
If a pre-1.2.1 save remains permanently stuck below five, start a fresh save and repurchase all five expansions for a clean counter.

achievements.description: Help Gigi stabilize the Prismacore and save Rainbow Island.
achievements.summary: Craft the Nullifier, activate all five Grey Labyrinth Harmonizers, then defeat the Prismacore Tarr outbreak.

guide.context: Gigi awards the Nullifier blueprint after enough stabilized Prisma Plorts are delivered. The device opens faintly rainbow-shimmering walls only while it remains deployed.

steps.text: Deliver stabilized Prisma Plorts to Gigi until she gives the Nullifier blueprint, then craft it for 1,000 newbucks plus 20 Shadow, 20 Twin, 20 Hyper, and 20 Sloomber Plorts.

Search the Grey Labyrinth's Prismacore surroundings, Dream Land, Impossible Sky, Mirage, and Shifting Caverns for five shimmering walls; deploy the Nullifier at each wall and fire any carried object at the Harmonizer bell behind it.
After all five bells ring, return to the Prismacore and speak to Gigi's hologram to begin the final encounter.
Use fresh water to destroy every Tarr cluster until a barrier surrounds the core, then collect the newly spawned slimes and fire them into the shower mechanisms.
Repeat the water-and-shower cycle until the Prismacore health bar empties and Rainbow Island is stabilized.

achievements.description: Place your first gadget.
achievements.summary: Enter Gadget Mode and place any gadget in the world.

guide.context: The opening tutorial supplies gadget access, but the same action works later if tutorial tips were disabled.

steps.text: Obtain any gadget from the tutorial, Comm Station, Polestar Provisions, or the Fabricator.
Press @mechanic{T} to enter Gadget Mode, choose a valid placement site, and confirm the gadget's placement.

achievements.description: Fire a plort through a linked cannon, sending it to the plort market.
achievements.summary: Send a plort through a paired @item{Linked Cannon} so the receiving cannon fires it into the Conservatory Plort Market.

guide.context: Linked Cannons are placed as an intake-output pair; the sale only counts when the output is aimed at the Plort Market rather than general storage.

steps.text: Craft a Linked Cannon at the Conservatory Fabricator and enter Gadget Mode.
Place the receiving cannon beside and facing the Plort Market, then place its linked intake at a convenient ranch or field location.
Fire any plort into the intake and wait for the linked receiver to launch that plort into the market chute.

achievements.description: Craft and use a Return Home Portal.
achievements.summary: Craft, deploy, and travel through a @item{Return Home Portal} to the Conservatory.

guide.context: The blueprint can arrive through Polestar Provisions or a Comm Station gift, so check both systems while advancing days.

steps.text: Acquire the Return Home Portal blueprint, deposit its recipe materials in the Refinery, and craft it at the Fabricator.
Deploy the portal outside the Conservatory, enter it, and complete the teleport back home.

achievements.description: Make three purchases at the Night Market.
achievements.summary: Spend three Night Market tokens on @mechanic{three purchases} from ProntoMart after dark.

guide.context: After the Prismacore is entered, Gigi exchanges every ten stabilized Prisma Plorts for one Night Market token.

steps.text: During a Prisma Disruption in the Grey Labyrinth, collect unstable plorts while preventing the vac's periodic ejections from losing them.
Fire each unstable plort through a yellow Prisma Stabilizer or Stabilizing Gate, collect the resulting Prisma Plorts, and deliver 30 total to Gigi for three tokens.
At night, open the Night Market section of ProntoMart in the Conservatory and spend the three tokens on any three items.

achievements.description: Get hit by a bolt of lightning.
achievements.summary: Stand inside a lightning strike warning until the bolt hits the player.

guide.context: During thunderstorms, a small circle of ground sparks appears several seconds before lightning lands.

steps.text: Travel in a region experiencing a thunderstorm and watch the ground for a concentrated sparking circle.
Move into the marked circle and remain there until the lightning bolt strikes the player.

achievements.description: Purchase 40 items in the Polestar Provisions shop.
achievements.summary: Buy a cumulative total of @mechanic{40 items} from the @loc{Polestar Provisions} shop.

guide.context: The shop opens after the first few in-game days; inexpensive stock counts, so this can be combined with useful blueprint and decoration purchases.

steps.text: Visit Polestar Provisions beside the Comm Station whenever its stock is available.
Purchase the cheapest useful items until the lifetime shop counter reaches 40 purchases.

achievements.description: Have a Strange Diamond, Sun Sap, Royal Jelly, and Lightning Mote in your vac at the same time.
achievements.summary: Keep four rare materials in the vac simultaneously: @item{Lightning Mote}, @item{Royal Jelly}, @item{Sun Sap}, and @item{Strange Diamond}.

guide.context: All four are rare, and Royal Jelly is late-game; storing the first three in a Silo prevents accidental loss while the Grey Labyrinth route is completed.

steps.text: Harvest Strange Diamond from cave resource nodes, Sun Sap from Powderfall Bluffs trees or the Grey Labyrinth Terrarium, and Lightning Mote from the ground after lightning strikes.
In the Grey Labyrinth's Dream Land area, harvest Royal Jelly from beehives with purple jelly dripping from them.
Return the stored materials to the vac so all four named resources occupy inventory slots at the same time.

achievements.description: Discover any three areas.
achievements.summary: Enter @mechanic{three named regions} of Rainbow Island.

guide.context: The Conservatory opens into Rainbow Fields; bursting the Cotton and Pink Gordos exposes the mechanisms for the two first teleporter routes.

steps.text: Feed the Cotton Gordo 30 vegetables, enter its cave, and activate the mechanism for one regional teleporter.
Feed the Pink Gordo 30 foods, descend through the geyser route, and activate the second mechanism.
Use the teleporters to enter Ember Valley and Starlight Strand so the third discovered region registers.

achievements.description: Break a Yolky Slime egg.
achievements.summary: Shoot a giant @item{Yolky Slime egg} into the ground until the egg breaks.

guide.context: Yolky Slimes appear rarely near wild chicken nests; keeping one in a Coop with hens and roostros causes a breakable giant egg to appear.

steps.text: Search wild chicken-nest areas for a Yolky Slime, then carry that slime to a Conservatory Coop stocked with Hen Hens and Roostros.
When a giant egg appears, vac the egg and fire it against the ground to release Chickadoos and Yolky Plorts.

achievements.description: Discover the entrance to Powderfall Bluffs.
achievements.summary: Power the hidden teleporter behind the upper @loc{Ember Valley waterfall} with Tabby, Boom, and Batty Plorts.

guide.context: The cave entrance needs the Jetpack, and roughly 150 energy gives enough margin to reach the waterfall ledge.

steps.text: Carry one @item{Tabby Plort}, one @item{Boom Plort}, and one @item{Batty Plort} to the waterfall in the northern half of Ember Valley.
Jetpack behind the waterfall, fire each plort into its matching statue, and use the activated teleporter to discover Powderfall Bluffs.

achievements.description: Open a door to the Grey Labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Open either Grey Labyrinth door by reflecting its yellow beam through two @item{Radiant Projectors}.

guide.context: One entrance lies behind the Flutter Gordo in Starlight Strand and another behind the Boom Gordo in Ember Valley; an opened door remains open after its projectors are recovered.

steps.text: Burst the Flutter Gordo or Boom Gordo, enter the room behind it, and bring two Radiant Projectors crafted at the Fabricator.
Place and rotate both projectors so the yellow source beam reaches the receiver; a blue outgoing beam means a projector is misaligned.
When the door opens, recover the projectors and walk through the glowing teleporter into the Grey Labyrinth.

achievements.description: Sell 15 different types of plorts.
achievements.summary: Sell at least one plort from each of @mechanic{15 different slime species} at the Conservatory Plort Market.

guide.context: The requirement tracks distinct plort types across the save, so the fifteen sales do not need to occur together.

steps.text: Collect plorts from slimes across Rainbow Fields, Ember Valley, Starlight Strand, Powderfall Bluffs, and the Grey Labyrinth.
Fire each new plort type into the Plort Market until 15 distinct types have been sold.

achievements.description: Loot 50 treasure pods.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{50 treasure pods} across Rainbow Island and the Grey Labyrinth.

guide.context: Unlike the first game, Slime Rancher 2 does not require a Treasure Cracker upgrade before opening its bright, multicolored pods.

steps.text: Explore each mapped region, investigate side paths and raised ledges, and open every bright treasure pod encountered.
Use the map's regional pod counters to revisit incomplete areas until 50 pods have been looted.

achievements.description: Use the Comm Station to receive a gift from Mochi, Viktor, Thora, Ogden, and BOb.
achievements.summary: Receive one Comm Station gift from each of @npc{Mochi, Viktor, Thora, Ogden, and BOb}.

guide.context: The Comm Station activates after the opening days, and new calls are time- and exploration-driven rather than available together.

steps.text: Check the Comm Station beside the Conservatory entrance after each long trip or sleep cycle.
Open incoming calls and accept the attached gift from BOb, Ogden, Thora, Viktor, and Mochi until all five contacts have contributed.

achievements.description: Craft 5 Quantum Drones.
achievements.summary: Craft a cumulative total of @mechanic{five Quantum Drones} at the Fabricator.

guide.context: Each craft needs one Drone Station Module. Ghostly Drones roam worldwide and award a module when activated while stationary; the first module also reveals the blueprint.

steps.text: Collect five modules from accessible Ghostly Drones, such as the first purchased ranch expansion, Digsite, Tidepools, Rainbow Fields' central mountain, and Starlight Strand's large two-colored tree.
At the Conservatory Fabricator, pay 5,000 newbucks and provide 100 Flutter Plorts, 15 Lava Dust, 15 Wild Honey, 2 Strange Diamonds, and one Drone Station Module for each Quantum Drone.
Craft an early Quantum Drone and deploy it in Explorer Mode near needed materials, then use its passive harvests to supply the remaining four crafts.

achievements.description: Feed 3 Gordos to bursting.
achievements.summary: Feed any @mechanic{three different Gordos} until all three burst.

guide.context: The nearby Cotton, Pink, and Phosphor Gordos provide an early route; early Gordos take about 30 normal food units, while favorites count more efficiently.

steps.text: Burst the Cotton Gordo with vegetables and the Pink Gordo with any food to open the first regional routes.
Locate the nearby Phosphor Gordo, feed it fruit until it bursts, and confirm the third completed Gordo triggers the achievement.

achievements.description: Fill 10 Shadow Plort Collectors in the Grey Labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Completely fill @mechanic{10 Shadow Plort Collectors} throughout the Grey Labyrinth.

guide.context: Shadow Slimes cannot be vacuumed. Food hits make them drop Shadow Plorts without consuming the food, and collector capacities vary by location.

steps.text: Carry plentiful food through the Grey Labyrinth and fire it at fleeing Shadow Slimes or break shadow-filled jars to create more targets.
Vac the dropped Shadow Plorts and deposit them into any collector until its dial's moon symbol reaches the center and the collector opens.
Repeat with additional collectors until ten separate Shadow Plort Collectors have opened.

achievements.description: Earn 100000 newbucks from selling plorts.
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative @mechanic{100,000 newbucks} by selling plorts at the Conservatory Plort Market.

guide.context: Spending does not erase progress because the achievement counts sale income earned over the save, not the current wallet balance.

steps.text: Feed high-value largos their favorite foods, collect both resulting plort types, and sell them at the Plort Market.
Continue ordinary sales until cumulative plort revenue reaches 100,000 newbucks.

achievements.description: Get a score of 120 on a Slimeball goal gadget within 1 minute.
achievements.summary: Score @mechanic{120 points within one minute} on a deployed Slimeball Goal.

guide.context: Placing the goal against the back of the Phosphor Gordo cave restricts its movement and makes repeated shots far more consistent.

steps.text: Acquire and craft the Slimeball Goal, then collect at least 60 small slimes across enlarged vac slots.
At the far end of the emptied Phosphor Gordo cave, deploy the goal facing the back wall so it cannot drift sideways freely.
Start the one-minute game and fire slimes continuously through the moving goal until the displayed score reaches 120.

achievements.description: Shoot a tarr into a tornado.
achievements.summary: Launch a newly created @enemy{Tarr} into an active tornado during @mechanic{Wind level 3} weather.

guide.context: Tarr must be enabled in the save. A pure slime becomes a largo after one foreign plort, then becomes Tarr after eating a third species' plort.

steps.text: Zoom out on the map and wait for a region whose Wind indicator reaches level 3, shown by three red stripes; enter that region after tornadoes begin forming.

Bring one pure slime and two unrelated plort types nearby, feed the first plort to create a largo, feed that largo the second unrelated plort to create Tarr, and immediately fire the Tarr into a tornado.

achievements.description: Complete the Slimepedia.
achievements.summary: Complete the current Slimepedia route: 30 slime entries, 55 resources, nine weather events, 24 toys, seven world locations, and all Ranch and Science entries.

guide.context: Blueprint and player-upgrade pages are excluded. The safe Steam post-1.2 route includes the Radiant Slimes entry, Resource Detector toy, Glo Glo Foxifur platform toy, and Sprinkles resource.

steps.text: Finish the story, buy all Conservatory expansions, enter every region, and clear the Ranch and Science tabs through normal facilities and gadget progression.

Register all 30 slime entries; enable Tarr, create one by feeding a largo an unrelated third plort, collect at least one Radiant Slime, and prioritize rare Gold, Lucky, Yolky, Tangle, Dervish, Sloomber, Twin, Hyper, and Shadow entries.
Collect all 55 resource entries, including every hen and chick type, the late Grey Labyrinth materials, and Sprinkles from the Radiant Slime Sanctuary.
Experience all nine weather events in their eligible regions and confirm every Weather tile is revealed.

Buy the single daily toy offered by ProntoMart; its stock resets at noon, so sleep in the Ranch House to advance days until all 24 toys, including Resource Detector and Steam's Glo Glo Foxifur, are registered.
Inspect each required Slimepedia category for unrevealed tiles and collect the named missing discovery until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Pet the ProntoMart cat.
achievements.summary: Pet the cat shown inside the @mechanic{ProntoMart shop menu}.

guide.context: The cat is part of ProntoMart's interface rather than a roaming animal in the Conservatory.

steps.text: Open ProntoMart's shop screen and select the visible cat to pet it once.
